description: This file defines dialog interfaces for list style customization in CKEditor, including bulleted and numbered list styles, with functions to get list elements and manage style options.

methods.name: getListElement
methods.description: Retrieves the common ancestor list element ('ul' or 'ol') from the current selection in the editor.

methods.name: listStyle
methods.description: Creates dialog configuration for list style options, handling bulleted and numbered list styles.
